formal_findings.claim: The declared unary-safe writer and reader are inverses on their input domain.
formal_findings.reason: Non-unary words retain a unit different from the shared tail after deleting exactly one final unit; unary words remain distinguishable and unchanged. The final full word fixes the restored tail.

formal_findings.claim: If gap grades are not independently supplied, every permitted paragraph string has an all-narrow interpretation.
formal_findings.reason: Use its final unit as the shared tail and append that unit to each earlier non-unary output word. Re-encoding returns the original strings. This is formal coverage, not manuscript evidence.

formal_findings.claim: Once gap grades are fixed, consecutive block-final units must differ.
formal_findings.reason: Otherwise the declared maximal equal-ending runs would merge. The tail class is invariant under any global bijective renaming.

formal_findings.claim: All gaps inside the final consecutive run of same-ending output words must be narrow.
formal_findings.reason: Any wide gap within that terminal run would leave the final wide-separated block and its predecessor with the same ending unit. This is a prospective conditional observation, not an observed native counterexample.
